goal: Connect every Provider mode materialized candidate to the existing canonical verification, governance, acceptance, promotion, packaging, and public-delivery authority chain.
acceptance_criteria: A new zero-provider text-counter smoke reaches public delivery and its ZIP runs after independent extraction with valid canonical hashes.
Candidate materialization transitions into canonical verification for live, codex_surrogate, and deterministic_replay without a Provider-mode-specific finalizer.
Canonical verification, Product Design governance, goal fidelity, proxy, maturity, and acceptance decisions bind the exact candidate identity and evidence hashes.
Frozen partial acceptance, Product Design Governance rules, Provider scheduler, surrogate ingestion, and the sole local_packager exit remain unchanged.
Only an accepted candidate receives an idempotent promotion manifest and only promoted projects can reach local_packager.
User-review requirements come from the existing policy and yield WAITING_USER_REVIEW without synthetic or surrogate review authority.

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

feedback: Fresh codex_surrogate generation reached canonical verification, governance, acceptance, promotion, local_packager, and public delivery with zero real Provider and network calls.
Independent ZIP extraction passed four tests and a Chinese-path CLI run; canonical manifest and package hashes were recomputed successfully.
The relevant regression profile passed 273 tests and the new finalization suite contains 35 tests.

worked: A single mode-neutral post-build finalizer preserved Provider, governance, acceptance, packaging, and delivery authority boundaries.
Hash-bound state artifacts made restart and idempotency behavior directly testable.
did_not_work: The first fresh smoke exposed package-entrypoint classification and final warning-verdict state persistence gaps after canonical promotion.
experiments: Keep the finalization smoke as a zero-provider release-path probe and require independent extraction for future delivery-chain changes.
